raw_evidence_cards.document_title: ScaGNN: a Graph Neural Network for Multiple Scattering Simulations
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposed a new learning-based approach for simulating Multiple Scattering phenomena using the BEM framework in which a GNN is leveraged as a surrogate model for replacing the BIE solver, leading to a reduction of the simulation runtime by two orders of magnitude.
differences: focuses on multiple scattering by multiple disjoint obstacles
uses dynamic adaptive edge sampling mechanism
introduces a benchmark for training and evaluating multiple scattering surrogate models

sources.title: ScaGNN: a Graph Neural Network for Multiple Scattering Simulations
sources.quote: We present a novel learning-based approach for simulating Multiple Scattering phenomena using the BEM framework in which a GNN is leveraged as a surrogate model for replacing the BIE solver. This leads to a reduction of the simulation runtime by two orders of magnitude.

raw_evidence_cards.document_title: BandPC: Learning Residual-Band Preconditioner Combinations for Flexible Conjugate Gradient Solvers
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposed a new distributed graph neural network training framework based on graph summarization, called DSGNN, for graph representation learning based on graph neural networks in distributed scenarios.
differences: The proposed work focuses on a different problem (sparse symmetric positive definite linear systems) and uses a different approach (graph neural networks for preconditioning).

sources.title: BandPC: Learning Residual-Band Preconditioner Combinations for Flexible Conjugate Gradient Solvers
sources.quote: The conjugate gradient (CG) method is a classical iterative solver for sparse symmetric positive definite (SPD) linear systems, but its convergence strongly depends on the spectral properties of the system matrix.

sources.title: BandPC: Learning Residual-Band Preconditioner Combinations for Flexible Conjugate Gradient Solvers
sources.quote: We propose BandPC (Band Preconditioner Combinations, where "Band" denotes residual-norm bands), a data-driven framework that leverages graph neural networks (GNNs) to predict multi-stage preconditioning strategies for the flexible conjugate gradient (FCG) method.

raw_evidence_cards.document_title: EvoFormer: Learning Dynamic Graph-Level Representations with Structural and Temporal Bias Correction
raw_evidence_cards.main_contribution: Proposed a new edge-segmentation-based graph stream partitioning algorithm, called Sketch-DBH, for handling subgraph partitioning problems in large-scale graph stream data.
differences: The proposed method focuses on dynamic graph-level embedding and addressing structural visit bias and abrupt evolution blindness, while Sketch-DBH targets subgraph partitioning in graph streams.
EvoFormer uses a Structure-Aware Transformer Module and an Evolution-Sensitive Temporal Module, whereas Sketch-DBH employs Count-Min Sketch and a minimum heap for efficient partitioning.

sources.title: EvoFormer: Learning Dynamic Graph-Level Representations with Structural and Temporal Bias Correction
sources.quote: To overcome these challenges, we propose EvoFormer, an evolution-aware Transformer framework tailored for dynamic graph-level representation learning.
